item.text:
ResStock 2025 Release 1 assigns AMY (Actual Meteorological Year) weather **by county**, with all housing units in a county using the same weather file:

- Use a weather station within the county when available.
- Otherwise, select the station closest to the county’s **population centroid**, prioritizing stations in the same climate zone.
- Shift timestamps if the selected station is in a different time zone.

The documentation describes **approximately 1,200 weather stations** for the 2018 AMY files, roughly matching TMY3 station locations. Nearby stations occasionally substitute when target-station data are missing.

Source: [ResStock Technical Reference Guide, 2025 Release 1, §8.1.5, “Mapping Weather Files to ResStock Samples,” p. 52](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=68).
